photo.annotation: Centre line of the documented geometric section, not a building boundary

config.section_basis: Reuse the frozen centre and long tangent axis1; use the selected component normal as axis2 so the displayed separation has the same direction as tau; cross axis is axis1 cross axis2
config.section_width_rule: Use the smallest listed half width with observations from all three sources in all 12 bins; otherwise use the widest and retain gaps. Decide from counts only, never from profile heights or separation.
config.aggregation: Median of actual projected coordinates in each fixed bin, independently for each source
config.missing_bins: Keep NaN gaps; do not interpolate or fit a curve
config.plot_y_limits: All finite bin medians and the full reference plus/minus tau band, plus max(10 percent of their range, 0.04 m) on either side; the plot is a binned profile, not all raw points
config.photo: Same R6 original photograph and crop; mark the section centre line A-A prime instead of the component hull
config.display: Use the same reference dots, prior dashed line and MVS solid line as the other cards; show a labelled grey reference plus/minus 20 cm band; explicitly state that normal separation is enlarged

source_view.rule: Exact original component normal, no tilted projection; separation is normal-direction distance

previous_tilted_view.rule: input component median and fixed 3m tangent radius; normal projection axis covers GT plus 1m margin; numbers remain entire-component values

local_paired_prior_audit.scope: All 241 matched prior/reference points in the original local input cloud; not the entire selected building

comparison.statistic: Actual-coordinate median per fixed 0.5 m bin; section width determined by point support alone, no fitted line and no shifted profile
comparison.limitations: MVS points pool the existing views; unequal per-bin density and outliers remain in the source record. Median profile is not a physical continuous surface or independent truth validation. Full-component 12/34 cm bar values do not describe this local section.

display.reference_band_semantics: Existing normal-direction tolerance around the binned reference profile; not a statistical confidence band
